title: FenceManifest
description:
Claim-filtered sparse materialization manifest (decomposition §1, item 6;
whitepaper §9.1).

Sparse materialization IS the fence. `deny_default = true` means paths not
listed are denied by default.

Frozen by WP-00.

deny_default.description:
Whether unlisted paths are denied by default (MUST be `true` in all
production manifests).

materialized.description: Actually materialised (path, digest) pairs at runtime.

path_set.description: Allowed path set (explicit allowlist of paths the claim may access).

MaterializedEntry.description: A (path, digest) pair for a materialised file entry.

digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file content.

path.description: Relative path of the materialized file.
